reasons: Both acceptance criteria are covered: AC1 by a full visible user path (Long -> place order -> Back) with a strict absent-assertion on the order form plus before/after screenshots, AC2 by focused unit tests run inside the recipe with an asserted exit code.

The recipe is falsifiable: the sibling recipe-baseline.json asserts the buggy values and passes on pre-fix code, the verify recipe passes only on fixed code, and removing pop: true makes the new PerpsOrderView unit test fail.

No banned patterns: no switch/default routing, no eval_* nodes, no wait-as-substitute-for-wait_for, every node id is prefixed ac<N>-/setup-/gate-/teardown-, and the order is submitted through ui.press against the form's own defaults rather than injected state.
All 20 nodes report ok: true in trace.json, and the screenshots were read directly rather than inferred from the recipe's pass status.
better_version_guidance: AC2 rests on unit tests because a live Pro add-funds proof needs a funded Arbitrum Sepolia deposit, an external mutation with no funding consent in this slot; a funded slot could exercise it end to end.

Visibility gates assert present rather than visible because this app's accessibility viewport probe reports visible: false for fixed-footer controls and the Perps home heading; a fixed probe would let the recipe assert visibility directly instead of leaning on the screenshot.

intent_clarity.reason: Every node intent states a human-visible goal rather than restating its action or selector; the runner's own intent validator rejected two drafts until they did.
evidence: mm-harness run --plan reported workflow.invalid_intent on ac1-press-back and gate-market-page before rewording; final plan passes.

coverage.reason: 2/2 ACs PROVEN with no weak or missing rows; AC2's live-device evidence is explicitly recorded UNTESTABLE with a concrete rationale.
evidence: artifacts/recipe-coverage.md coverage matrix; artifacts/trace.json shows all ac1-* and ac2-* nodes ok: true.

evidence_fit.reason: The mixed AC gets state assertions plus a screenshot; the state AC gets test output and an asserted exit code rather than a screenshot of hidden behaviour.
evidence: before-ac1-back-lands-on-order-screen.png shows the Long BTC trade screen, after-ac1-back-lands-on-perps-home.png shows Perps home carrying the just-placed BTC 3x long; artifacts/ac2-navigation-unit-tests.log reports 151 passed.

adapter_independence.reason: Only manifest-declared actions are used - ui.*, metamask.perps.*, metamask.wallet.*, app.status, command, assert_exit_code, index_artifacts - with no removed helpers or raw eval.
evidence: Validated against mm-harness actions --adapter mobile --json; mm-harness run --plan passes schema and action-existence checks.

flake_risk.reason: The recipe places a real testnet order, so it depends on Hyperliquid testnet availability and a funded fixture account, and it needs start_state to clean the market first or the Long control is replaced by Close/Modify.
evidence: setup-clean-market uses profile clean_market_testnet; ac1-wait-position-open allows 60s for the fill; an earlier run failed exactly this way when a position was left open.
